phase1.assumption: Lineage-safe memory consolidation relies on stable genetic factors across generations.
phase1.inversion: Lineage-safe memory consolidation is primarily driven by environmental epigenetic modifications rather than genetic stability.
predictions: Genetic mutations in key memory-related genes will significantly impair cross-generational memory retention.
Epigenetic markers will show consistent heritability in lineage-safe memory consolidation across generations.
Environmental interventions that disrupt epigenetic stability will correlate with reduced memory consolidation efficiency.
